{{Short description|Variety in algebraic geometry}}
In [[algebraic geometry]], a '''Spaltenstein variety''' is a variety given by the [[fixed point (mathematics)|fixed point]] set of a nilpotent transformation on a [[flag variety]]. They were introduced by {{harvs|txt|first=Nicolas|last=Spaltenstein|year1=1976|year2=1982}}. In the special case of full flag varieties the Spaltenstein varieties are [[Springer variety|Springer varieties]].
